EC1: Patients with a contraindication [AND] to VCE (small bowel strictures [OR], oropharyngeal dysphagia [OR], pregnancy [OR], patients who are [NOT] not surgical candidates)
EC2: Endoscopic insertion [AND] of video capsule endoscope
EC3: Inpatient procedures [AND] for active GI bleeding
EC4: Patients with fluid restriction [OR] or who are unable to drink up to 900 ml of fluid within 10 minutes prior to the VCE
